description: This file contains functions and types related to managing workflow reminders, including fetching reminders to delete, cancel, or retrieve unscheduled reminders, as well as utility functions for recipient email determination.

methods.name: getWorkflowReminders
methods.description: Fetches workflow reminders based on filter and select criteria, handling pagination.

methods.name: getAllRemindersToDelete
methods.description: Retrieves reminders marked for deletion based on specific criteria.

methods.name: getAllRemindersToCancel
methods.description: Retrieves reminders that need to be canceled based on specific criteria.

methods.name: getAllUnscheduledReminders
methods.description: Retrieves reminders that are scheduled but not yet sent, within a specific time window.

methods.name: getWorkflowRecipientEmail
methods.description: Determines the recipient email address based on the action type and provided email parameters.
